source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 16 exercise solved (PDF 71-72): MCQs with keys and reasons, model answers for short, long and inquisitive questions, Kitab ki ghalti and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 16 (Human Endocrine System) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Short Q9 ke aath joron ka farq table mein hai. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. Which of the following pair of hormones has antagonistic (opposing) effects?
(Kaun se do hormones ek doosre ke ulat (mukhalif) asar rakhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Parathormone khoon mein calcium barhata hai (haddi se calcium nikal kar, kidneys se wapas le kar), jab ke calcitonin calcium ghatata hai (calcium haddiyon mein jama kar ke) (16.2.3, 16.2.4).

blocks.prompt:
2. Which gland produces hormones that control other endocrine glands?
(Kaun si gland aise hormones banati hai jo doosri endocrine glands ko control karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Anterior pituitary TSH, ACTH, FSH aur LH banati hai jo thyroid, adrenal cortex aur gonads ko chalate hain (16.2.2).

blocks.prompt:
3. Which of the following is NOT released by anterior pituitary?
(Kaun sa hormone anterior pituitary se khaarij NAHI hota?)
blocks.explanation: ADH hypothalamus banata hai aur posterior pituitary khoon mein chhorti hai; prolactin, FSH aur TSH anterior pituitary ke hormones hain (16.2.2).

blocks.prompt:
4. Antidiuretic and oxytocin hormones are produced by
(Antidiuretic hormone aur oxytocin kahan bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Oxytocin aur ADH hypothalamus ke neurosecretory cells banate hain; posterior pituitary sirf inhein store karti aur chhorti hai (16.2.1).

blocks.prompt:
5. Which of the following hormones binds to the receptors located inside the cell?
(Kaun sa hormone cell ke andar maujood receptors se judta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Testosterone steroid hai (charbi mein ghulne wala), is liye cell membrane se guzar kar andar ke receptors se judta hai; FSH, insulin aur GH protein/glycoprotein hain, un ke receptors cell ki satah par hote hain (16.1.1).

blocks.prompt:
6. Which of the following is a function of a hormone released by the posterior pituitary?
(Posterior pituitary se nikalne wale hormone ka kaam kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Posterior pituitary se nikalne wala ADH (vasopressin) kidneys ko pani rokne par uksata hai (16.2.2).

blocks.prompt:
7. Which of the following hormones would be expected to increase if you were studying all day for a test and skipped breakfast and lunch?
(Agar aap saara din test ki tayyari karein aur nashta aur dopahar ka khana chhor dein to kaun sa hormone barhega?)
blocks.explanation: Khana na khane se blood glucose normal se kam ho jata hai; tab alpha cells glucagon chhorte hain jo liver ke glycogen ko glucose mein torta hai (16.2.5).

blocks.prompt:
8. Which of the following is both an endocrine and exocrine gland?
(Kaun si gland endocrine bhi hai aur exocrine bhi?)
blocks.explanation: Pancreas pancreatic juice duct mein dalta hai (exocrine) aur islets of Langerhans se insulin aur glucagon seedha khoon mein (endocrine) (16.2.5).

blocks.prompt:
9. Which hormone increases basal metabolic rate in the body?
(Kaun sa hormone jism ka basal metabolic rate barhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thyroxine (T4) aur T3 cellular respiration tez karte hain aur jism ka basal metabolic rate tay karte hain (16.2.3).

blocks.prompt:
10. Which of the following is NOT a site of action of insulin?
(Kaun si jagah insulin ke asar ki jagah NAHI?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter ke mutabiq insulin skeletal muscles aur charbi (fat) cells mein glucose dakhil karwata hai aur liver mein glycogen banwata hai; smooth muscles in mein shamil nahi (16.2.5).

blocks.prompt:
1. State the role of hormones as chemical messengers.
Hormones ka chemical messengers (kimiyai paigham-rasan) ke tor par kirdar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Hormones endocrine glands ke banaye hue kimiyai (chemical) paigham hain jo seedha khoon mein jate hain. Khoon inhein har cell tak le jata hai, magar har hormone sirf apne target cells par asar karta hai jin mein us ke makhsoos receptors hote hain; judne par cell khaas jawab deta hai. Yun yeh growth, metabolism aur reproduction jaise lambe arse ke kaam control karte hain (chemical coordination).

blocks.prompt:
2. Where are receptors located in amino acid-based hormones and steroid hormones?
Amino acid se bane hormones aur steroid hormones ke receptors kahan hote hain?
blocks.explanation:
Amino acid wale (peptide, protein, glycoprotein) hormones pani mein ghulte hain aur cell membrane se nahi guzar sakte, is liye un ke receptors cell ki satah (cell membrane) par hote hain.
Steroid hormones charbi (lipid) mein ghulte hain aur membrane se guzar jate hain, is liye un ke receptors cell ke andar, cytoplasm ya nucleus mein hote hain.

blocks.prompt:
3. What are neurosecretory cells?
Neurosecretory cells kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Neurosecretory cells hypothalamus ke khaas nerve cells hain jo nerve impulse bhi le jate hain aur hormones bhi banate hain. Yeh oxytocin aur ADH banate hain (jo axons ke zariye posterior pituitary jate hain) aur woh releasing aur inhibiting hormones bhi jo anterior pituitary ko control karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
4. Name the hormones of anterior pituitary gland.
Anterior pituitary gland ke hormones ke naam likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Growth hormone (GH, somatotropin)
2. Adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH, corticotropin)
3. Thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH, thyrotropin)
4. Luteinizing hormone (LH)
5. Follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH)
6. Prolactin

blocks.prompt:
5. Why the pituitary gland is called master gland?
Pituitary gland ko master gland kyun kehte hain?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke is ka anterior hissa aise hormones banata hai jo kai doosri endocrine glands ko control karte hain: TSH thyroid ko, ACTH adrenal cortex ko, aur FSH aur LH gonads (ovaries aur testes) ko. Yeh GH aur prolactin bhi banati hai jo seedha jism ke tissues par asar karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
6. How is the secretion of ADH controlled?
ADH ka ikhraj (secretion) kaise control hota hai?
blocks.explanation: ADH hypothalamus ke neurosecretory cells banate hain aur axons ke zariye posterior pituitary mein store hota hai; hypothalamus ke ishare par hi khoon mein chhora jata hai. Jab khoon gaarha ho jaye (pani ki kami), hypothalamus ADH chhurwata hai aur kidneys pani rok leti hain; jab khoon patla ho, ADH kam ho jata hai (negative feedback; khoon ki gaarhapan mehsoos karne wali baat chapter se bahar hai).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: ADH = Anti (khilaf) + diuretic (zyada peshab). Yani yeh peshab kam karta hai aur pani jism mein rokta hai. Is ki kami se diabetes insipidus hota hai: bohat zyada patla peshab aur baar baar pyaas.

blocks.prompt:
7. Write a note on parathyroid glands.
Parathyroid glands par note likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Thyroid ki pichhli satah par chaar chhoti glands; khoon mein calcium kam ho to parathormone chhorti hain. Yeh osteoclasts se haddi ka calcium khoon mein nikalwata hai, kidneys se calcium wapas lewata hai aur aanton mein calcium jazb karne ke liye vitamin D ko active karta hai.
Zyada ikhraj: naram, tedhi haddiyan aur hypercalcaemia (nervous system sust, muscles kamzor). Kam ikhraj: hypocalcaemia, neurons ka zyada bhadakna aur tetany (muscles akre rehna).

blocks.prompt:
8. Write the names and functions of hormones secreted by ovaries and testes.
Ovaries aur testes ke hormones ke naam aur kaam likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Ovaries: estrogen (Graafian follicle se) aurat ki secondary sexual khususiyaat banata, menstrual cycle chalata aur uterus ki andaruni teh ki marammat karta hai; progesterone (corpus luteum aur placenta se) uterus ki deewar mazboot karta, hamal (pregnancy) qaim rakhta aur FSH aur ovulation rokta hai.
Testes: testosterone (androgen, interstitial cells se) mard ke reproductive aaza ko pakata, secondary sex khususiyaat aur sex drive paida karta aur sperm banne ke liye zaroori hai.
Dono glands secretions (rattoobat) chhorti hain; farq duct (naali) ka hai.

rows: Hormones seedha khoon ya tissue fluid mein

blocks.explanation: Dono thyroid ki bimariyan hain, ek doosre ki ulat.

rows: Susti, wazan barhna, dil ki raftar aur jism ka darja hararat kam
Wazan ghatna, blood pressure, dil ki raftar aur hararat zyada
Bachon mein cretinism, myxoedema, goitre (iodine ki kami)
Misal: Graves' disease (thyroid bara, aankhein bahar)

blocks.explanation: Dono khoon ka calcium control karte hain, ulti simt mein.

rows: Khoon ka calcium kam ho to nikalta hai
Khoon ka calcium zyada ho to nikalta hai
Calcium barhata hai: haddi se calcium, kidneys se wapsi, vitamin D active
Calcium ghatata hai: calcium haddiyon mein jama

blocks.explanation: Dono islets of Langerhans ke cells hain.

rows: Blood glucose barhe to kaam karte hain
Blood glucose ghate to kaam karte hain

blocks.explanation: Dono pancreas ke hormones hain jin ka blood glucose par ulat asar hai.

rows: Cells mein glucose dakhil, glycogen aur charbi banwata hai
Liver ka glycogen tor kar glucose banwata hai
Blood glucose normal se kam ho to nikalta hai

blocks.explanation: Dono mein peshab zyada aata hai, magar wajah alag hai.

rows: Insulin ki kami se (ya Type II mein insulin ka asar kam)
Bohat zyada patla peshab aur baar baar pyaas
Glucose pani ki wapsi rokta hai: zyada peshab, pani ki kami, kidney ko nuqsan

blocks.explanation: Dono ovaries ke female sex hormones hain.

rows: FSH ke asar se Graafian follicle banata hai
LH ke asar se corpus luteum banata hai; placenta bhi
Secondary sexual khususiyaat, uterus ki teh ki marammat
Uterus ki deewar mazeed moti aur khoon wali, hamal qaim
Menstrual cycle aur ovulation chalata hai
FSH rokta hai aur ovulation band karta hai

blocks.explanation: Dono endocrine system ke feedback tareeqe hain; ulat tareeqe se kaam karte hain.

rows: Natija control karne wale nizam ko aur tez karta hai
Aakhri natija pehla qadam rok deta hai
Misal: oxytocin, bachche ki paidaish tak contractions tez
Misal: normal blood glucose insulin (ya glucagon) band kar deta hai

blocks.prompt:
1. Explain the neurosecretory role of hypothalamus.
Hypothalamus ka neurosecretory kirdar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Pituitary master gland hai, magar khud dimagh ka hissa hypothalamus usay control karta hai. Hypothalamus mein neurosecretory cells hain jo nerve impulse bhi le jate hain aur hormones bhi banate hain.
Posterior pituitary ka control: neurosecretory cells oxytocin aur ADH banate hain; un ke axons yeh hormones posterior pituitary tak le jate hain jahan yeh store hote hain aur baad mein khoon mein chhore jate hain.
Anterior pituitary ka control: khoon ki naaliyan hypothalamus ko anterior pituitary se jorti hain. Neurosecretory cells hormones banate hain jo in naaliyon se guzar kar jate hain. Yeh do qisam ke hain:
1. Releasing hormones anterior pituitary ko hormones banane aur chhorne par uksate hain.
2. Inhibiting hormones anterior pituitary ke hormones ko rokte hain.
Misalein: GH-releasing hormone → GH; somatostatin → GH rokta hai; TRH → TSH; adrenocorticotropin-releasing hormone → ACTH; prolactin-inhibiting factor (dopamine) → prolactin rokta hai; gonadotropin-releasing hormone → FSH aur LH.
Yun hypothalamus nervous system ko endocrine system se jorta hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Describe the chemical nature of hormones.
Hormones ki kimiyai (chemical) nature bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Kimiyai banawat ke lehaz se hormones chaar qisam ke hain:
1. Peptide aur protein hormones: amino acids ki zanjeerein; pani mein ghulte hain, is liye khoon mein ghul jate hain magar cell membrane se nahi guzarte aur cell ki satah ke receptors se judte hain. Misal: insulin, glucagon (pancreas), growth hormone (anterior pituitary), oxytocin (hypothalamus).
2. Glycoprotein hormones: conjugated proteins (protein + carbohydrate); bare, pecheeda aur polar molecules jo membrane se nahi guzarte. Misal: TSH, FSH, LH (anterior pituitary).
3. Amino acid derivatives: ek amino acid (tyrosine ya tryptophan) se bane chhote molecules. Epinephrine aur norepinephrine (adrenal medulla) membrane se nahi guzarte; thyroxine (T4) aur tri-iodothyronine (T3) guzar jate hain.
4. Steroid hormones: cholesterol se bante hain; charbi (lipid) mein ghulte hain, is liye membrane se guzar kar cell ke andar (cytoplasm ya nucleus) ke receptors par asar karte hain. Misal: cortisol, aldosterone (adrenal cortex), testosterone (testes), estrogen aur progesterone (ovaries).
Har soorat mein hormone sirf un target cells par asar karta hai jin mein us ka makhsoos receptor ho.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ke chapter (16.1.1) mein likha hai "three main chemical categories" magar aage chaar qismein bayan ki gayi hain. Imtehan mein chaaron qismein likhein: protein/peptide, glycoprotein, amino acid derivatives aur steroids.

blocks.prompt:
3. State the names of the hormones secreted by pituitary gland. Write the function of each hormone and state the major abnormalities caused by the imbalance of pituitary hormones.
Pituitary gland ke hormones ke naam, har hormone ka kaam aur pituitary hormones ki kami/zyadti se hone wali bari kharabiyan likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Pituitary gland infundibulum ke zariye hypothalamus se judi hai aur is ke teen hisse (lobes) hain.
A. Anterior pituitary:
1. Growth hormone (GH): muscles, haddiyon aur tissues ki growth; metabolism ka control.
2. ACTH: adrenal cortex se corticosteroids nikalwata hai.
3. TSH: thyroid se thyroxine banwata hai.
4. LH: aurat mein estrogen, progesterone aur ovulation; mard mein testosterone.
5. FSH: aurat mein ovarian follicles ki nashonuma; mard mein sperms ki tayyari.
6. Prolactin: mammary glands mein doodh banwata hai.
B. Posterior pituitary (hypothalamus ke hormones store kar ke chhorti hai):
1. ADH (vasopressin): kidneys se pani rokwata hai.
2. Oxytocin: doodh nikalna aur paidaish ke waqt uterus ke contractions.
C. Intermediate pituitary: MSH jild aur baalon ke melanocytes se melanin banwata hai.
Kharabiyan:
1. Bachpan mein GH zyada: gigantism; bare ho kar: acromegaly (haath, paon, khopri, naak, jabra bare).
2. GH ki kami: dwarfism (qad chhota, jism mutanasib, IQ theek).
3. TSH zyada: hyperthyroidism; kam: hypothyroidism.
4. ADH ki kami: diabetes insipidus (zyada patla peshab, pyaas); zyadti se kidney ke masail.
5. Oxytocin zyada: uterus ki deewar phatna; kam: normal labour mein rukawat.

blocks.prompt:
4. Describe the functions of thyroid hormones. What are major diseases due to their imbalance?
Thyroid hormones ke kaam bayan karein. In ki kami/zyadti se kaun si bari bimariyan hoti hain?
blocks.explanation:
Thyroid gardan mein trachea ke dono taraf titli (butterfly) ki shakal ki do lobes wali gland hai.
Hormones aur kaam:
1. Thyroxine (T4) aur tri-iodothyronine (T3) (T4 badal kar zyada taqatwar T3 banta hai): dil aur saans ki raftar barhate hain; cellular respiration tez karte aur basal metabolic rate tay karte hain; glucose ka tootna aur liver mein cholesterol banna barhate hain; bachon mein haddiyon ki growth aur dimagh ki nashonuma.
2. Calcitonin: khoon mein calcium zyada ho to calcium haddiyon mein jama karwa kar khoon ka calcium kam karta hai.
Bimariyan:
1. Hypothyroidism (kami): growth ruk jana, susti, wazan barhna, qabz, zyada cholesterol, dil ki raftar aur hararat kam.
2. Cretinism: hamal aur bachpan mein hypothyroidism; qad chhota aur zehni kamzori.
3. Myxoedema: shadeed hypothyroidism; connective tissue mein mucopolysaccharides jama ho kar jild sooj aur moti ho jati hai.
4. Goitre: iodine ki kami se thyroid ka soojna.
5. Hyperthyroidism (zyadti): wazan ghatna; blood pressure, dil ki raftar aur hararat zyada; maslan Graves' disease (autoimmune, thyroid bara, aankhein bahar).

blocks.prompt:
5. Write a detailed note on adrenal glands mentioning the hormones of adrenal context and adrenal medulla and their functions.
Adrenal glands par tafseeli note likhein, adrenal cortex aur adrenal medulla ke hormones aur un ke kaam samet.
blocks.explanation:
Har kidney ke bilkul upar ek adrenal gland hai. Is ka andaruni hissa adrenal medulla aur bairooni hissa adrenal cortex hai.
A. Adrenal medulla (nervous system control karta hai):
Hormones: epinephrine (adrenaline) aur norepinephrine (noradrenaline), jo pareshani (stress) mein nikalte hain. Yeh jism ko 'fight or flight' (larna ya bhaagna) ke liye tayyar karte hain: dil ki raftar aur blood pressure zyada, saans ki naaliyan (bronchioles) khulti hain, blood glucose barhta hai, jild aur hazme ke aaza ko khoon kam.
B. Adrenal cortex (anterior pituitary ka ACTH control karta hai): is ke hormones corticosteroids hain.
1. Glucocorticoids, maslan cortisol: glucose ka tawazun; muscle protein ko amino acids mein torte aur liver se gluconeogenesis (amino acids → glucose) karwate hain.
2. Mineralocorticoids, maslan aldosterone: kidneys se sodium (aur saath pani) wapas lewata hai, khoon ki miqdar aur pressure qaim; zaid potassium peshab mein nikalwata hai.
Kami/zyadti:
1. Medulla hormones zyada: hypertension aur ghussa; kam: emergency ka muqabla na kar sakna.
2. Cortisol zyada: Cushing disease (zyada sugar aur blood pressure, kamzor haddiyan, muscle ghatna, naazuk jild, depression, aurton mein chehre par baal).
3. Cortisol kam: Addison's disease (metabolism mein khalal, kamzor muscles, namkiyat ka nuqsan).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "adrenal context" chhapa hai; sahi lafz "adrenal cortex" hai (adrenal gland ka bairooni hissa).

blocks.prompt:
6. Write a note on pancreas as an endocrine gland.
Pancreas par endocrine gland ke tor par note likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Pancreas zyada tar exocrine hai (pancreatic juice duct mein), magar is mein endocrine cells ke tukre (patches) bhi hain jinhein islets of Langerhans kehte hain. Har islet mein do qisam ke cells hain:
1. Beta (β) cells (zyada tadaad) blood glucose barhne par insulin chhorte hain. Insulin blood glucose kam karta hai: skeletal muscles aur fat cells mein glucose dakhil, liver mein glycogen banna (glycogenesis), respiration mein glucose ka zyada istemal, zaid glucose ko charbi banana aur gluconeogenesis rokna.
2. Alpha (α) cells blood glucose normal se kam hone par glucagon chhorte hain. Glucagon zyada tar liver ke glycogen ko tor kar glucose banata aur blood glucose barhata hai.
Dono negative feedback se control hote hain: normal blood glucose in ka ikhraj rok deta hai.
Kami/zyadti:
1. Insulin ki kami: diabetes mellitus (hyperglycaemia); zaid glucose pani ki wapsi rokta hai, zyada peshab, pani ki kami aur kidney ko nuqsan. Type I mein β cells nahi hote, insulin ke injection; Type II mein cells par insulin ka asar kam (dawai, khurak, warzish).
2. Insulin ki zyadti: hypoglycaemia (susti, chakkar, ghabrahat, behoshi).

blocks.prompt:
7. Describe the functions of the hormones secreted by thymus glans, pineal gland, kidneys, and walls of digestive tract.
Thymus gland, pineal gland, kidneys aur hazme ki nali ki deewaron ke hormones ke kaam bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Thymus gland (sternum ke neeche, phephron ke darmiyan): thymosin banati hai jo T cells ko pakata hai; T cells jism ko jaraseem (pathogens) se bachate hain.
2. Pineal gland (dimagh ki bunyad ke qareeb): melatonin banati hai jo neend ka nizam chalata hai.
3. Kidneys: renin adrenal glands mein aldosterone banne ko control karta hai; erythropoietin bone marrow se RBCs banwata hai; calcitriol aanton se calcium jazb karwa kar khoon ka calcium barhata hai.
4. Hazme ki nali ki deewarein: gastrin (maide ki deewar) gastric glands se gastric juice nikalwata hai; secretin (chhoti aant) pancreas se pancreatic juice nikalwata hai; cholecystokinin (chhoti aant) gallbladder se bile (pitta) nikalwata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "thymus glans" chhapa hai; sahi "thymus gland" hai.

blocks.prompt:
1. State the role of artificially synthesized steroids in sports and their long-term effects on its users.
Khel mein masnooi (artificial) steroids ka kirdar aur istemal karne walon par in ke lambe arse ke asraat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Masnooi (anabolic) steroids testosterone ki banawati (synthetic) shakal hain. Kuch khiladi inhein muscle, taqat aur bardasht (endurance) barhane ke liye lete hain, magar khel mein in ka istemal ghair-qanooni aur mamnoo (banned) hai.
Lambe arse ke asraat:
1. Liver ko nuqsan, hepatitis aur liver ki rasoliyan (tumours).
2. Dil ki bimari, stroke aur khoon jamne ka khatra.
3. Qudrati hormones ka tawazun bigarna: banjhpan (infertility), namardi aur mardon mein chhati barhna.
4. Zehni masail: depression, bechaini aur ghussa.

blocks.prompt:
2. Explain on what grounds some companies claim that growth is possible in people having short heights.
Wazahat karein ke kuch companiyan kis bunyad par dawa karti hain ke chhote qad wale logon ka qad barh sakta hai.
blocks.explanation:
In ka dawa growth hormone (GH) par mabni hai: anterior pituitary ka GH muscles, haddiyon aur tissues ki growth karta hai, aur jin bachon ka qad GH ki kami (dwarfism) ki wajah se chhota ho un mein GH ka ilaaj growth barhata hai. Companiyan yahi baat har kisi par laagu kar deti hain.
Magar har chhote qad wale mein GH ki kami nahi hoti, aur bare ho kar haddiyan lambai mein nahi barh saktin (tab GH sirf haddiyan moti karta hai, jaise acromegaly). Is liye GH ka ilaaj har kisi ke liye munasib nahi, aur doctor muscle banane ya budhapa rokne ke liye GH ki himayat nahi karte. Qad wirasat (genes) aur khurak par bhi munhasir hai (chapter se bahar).
